bear.label: Adoption stalls; Accelsius EV near post-Series-B mark; heavy dilution

component_valuation.coverage_statement: Four additive components: net cash, Accelsius look-through claim, other operating-company residual, dilution/burn reserve.

valuation.falsifier: Cash falls below $30M while quarterly burn stays above $15M

valuation.evidence: 10-K: Innventure LLC owns 43.2% of Accelsius as of 2026-03-23. Magis Accelsius onsite 2026-04-17: Series A ~$28M@$135M post; Series B strategics ~$65M (JCI/Legrand); Dark NX $55M contract; exit talk $1-3B. INV/investor-documents/research-notes/2026-04-17_Accelsius.pdf
valuation.assumption_summary: Risked Accelsius EV today low/base/high with ownership ~35-43%; year-5 base EV $1200.0M at 40% for yield-curve payoff
valuation.falsifier: Accelsius fails to book meaningful revenue by YE2027 or INV ownership falls below 25% without offsetting cash proceeds

risk_and_timing.probability_basis: Risked Accelsius EV today low/base/high with ownership ~35-43%; year-5 base EV $1200.0M at 40% for yield-curve payoff
risk_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Parent burn + subsidiary self-funding path per Magis/10-K

valuation.evidence: 10-K: Innventure LLC owns 37.1% AeroFlexx and 68.5% Refinity Holdings as of 2026-03-23
valuation.falsifier: Either subsidiary requires parent capital beyond Magis-described self-funding path for two consecutive years

valuation.evidence: 10-Q Q1 2026 net loss to stockholders ~$20.8M; S-3 shelf capacity; preferred designations
valuation.falsifier: Parent raises large primary equity that cuts Accelsius claim without strategic co-investment

economic_value.accounting_reference: FY2025 10-K and Q1 2026 10-Q; GAAP consolidates Accelsius with large NCI and intangibles; economic claim is look-through ownership plus cash.

economic_claim.description: One diluted INV common share: net cash, look-through Accelsius claim (Innventure LLC 43.2% filing ownership), AeroFlexx/Refinity residual, less dilution/burn reserve.
economic_claim.enterprise_to_equity_reconciliation: Parent consolidates subsidiaries with NCI; equity claim uses disclosed Innventure LLC ownership percentages, not 100% of consolidated Accelsius EV. Cash is parent-level. Intangibles/goodwill are GAAP cross-check only.
